answer: A bond of 23% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in zephyr, and bridge reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 118 aliases, and each one needs its own funded quill account. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 23 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
